# Heading one

A paragraph with **strong**, *emphasis*, ~~strike~~ and `inline code`.

A [link](https://example.com), a [titled link](https://example.com "Title") and an
![image](./cat.png "A cat").

A [**bold link**](https://example.com) keeps the link outermost.

A line ending in a hard break\
continues on the next line.
